citations.title: N.C. Gen. Stat. § 105-467 (scope of local sales tax, Article 39)
citations.quote: The sales price of food that is not otherwise exempt from tax pursuant to G.S. 105-164.13 but is exempt from the State sales and use tax pursuant to G.S. 105-164.13B.

notes: North Carolina taxes qualifying food at a 2.00% local rate only: the county's general local sales taxes (Articles 39, 40 and 42) apply to it and the transit and other local taxes (e.g. Articles 43 and 46) don't. A reduced rule's rate replaces each local part's rate, so the 2% is given to the part carrying the county's general local tax and the transit or additional parts are exempt; a single rate on every local part would double-count it where a transit tax applies. The NCDOR food page is undated and § 105-164.13B was last amended by S.L. 2015-6 before S.L. 2026-31 (whose change, to the artisan bakery provisions, wasn't read); 2018-01-01 is the earliest date taken as verified.
